subject: Output directory for knitr'd files in RStudio

messages.author: c584965fac2b99d6
messages.subject: Output directory for knitr'd files in RStudio
parts:
I'm trying to sort out a workflow for generating md files from RStudio using knitr that I can use as the basis for generating pdf, epub and mobi documents using leanpub (leanpub.com).

leanpub seems to expect that image files are located in an images directory, rather than figure/ which is the default used in the RStudio/knitr context,

Is there anyway I can specify the images directory in a knitr setting?

thanks
tony

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Output directory for knitr'd files in RStudio
parts:
You can set the path to the figures directory globally by including the following chunk in your Rmd file.

```{r setup, echo = F}
opts_chunk$set(fig.path = "images/")
```
